```gherkin
Feature: Ventilator GUI Functionality

  Scenario: Display FiO2 as measured prior to patient inhale limb
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the user views the GUI
    Then the FiO2 value is displayed as measured prior to the patient inhale limb

  Scenario: Set PIP from 5-55 cmH2O with increments of 1 cm H2O
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the user sets PIP to 5 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 5 cmH2O
    When the user increments PIP by 1 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 6 cmH2O
    When the user sets PIP to 55 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 55 cmH2O
    When the user increments PIP beyond 55 cmH2O
    Then an error message is displayed indicating PIP is out of range

  Scenario: Detect controller shutdown
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the controller is shut down
    Then the GUI displays a shutdown message

  Scenario: Set rise time parameter in [CPAP, PSV] modes
    Given the ventilator is in CPAP mode
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to 10 seconds
    Then the rise time value is displayed as 10 seconds
    Given the ventilator is in PSV mode
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to 15 seconds
    Then the rise time value is displayed as 15 seconds
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to a value outside the valid range
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the rise time is out of range

  Scenario: Set rise parameter in the range of 0..20% of breath cycle time
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the user sets the rise parameter to 0%
    Then the rise parameter value is displayed as 0%
    When the user sets the rise parameter to 20%
    Then the rise parameter value is displayed as 20%
    When the user sets the rise parameter to a value outside the valid range
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the rise parameter is out of range

  Scenario: Specify assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the user selects pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Then the assist/control mode is displayed as pressure controlled ventilation

  Scenario Outline: Set PIP with edge and invalid values
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the user sets PIP to <value>
    Then the PIP value is displayed as <value>
    Examples:
      | value  |
      | 5      |
      | 55     |
      | -1     |
      | 56     |

  Scenario Outline: Set rise time parameter with edge and invalid values
    Given the ventilator is in CPAP mode
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to <value>
    Then the rise time value is displayed as <value>
    Examples:
      | value  |
      | 10     |
      | 15     |
      | -1     |
      | 16     |

  Scenario Outline: Set rise parameter with edge and invalid values
    Given the ventilator is in normal operation mode
    When the user sets the rise parameter to <value>
    Then the rise parameter value is displayed as <value>
    Examples:
      | value  |
      | 0      |
      | 20     |
      | -1     |
      | 21     |
```
